lines.t: Step in the spot, here's the scene, silver clocks ticking
Yahushua at the table, every heart quickening
He's the owner, general manager, chef and busboy
Running every section, every soul, every floor
We the waiters in his house, call it living cuisine
Waitin' for his order, servin' truth so clean
Orders up, orders up, Yahushua takes a seat
We servin' with the love, hustlin' the heat
Floor sweet, dishwash, caterin' to him
From kitchen to the dining, gotta let our service win
He's chef, preppin' lessons, every truth is gourmet
We take it to the tables, plate it up his way
He's the busboy too, humble in emotion
Clearin' out the mess, pourin' living water
The ocean needs the GM calling shots every shift and every turn
We post up in position just to wait, watch and learn
Faith is the apron, truth is the tray
We walk with the master, never go astray
The menu is mercy, the specials are great
We rush to the table, just to see his face
Reservation made, he got the house on lock
No tip needed, we give all, never clock
Service ain't just labor, it's a call, it's devotion
Every plate handed him is an act of emotion From table to table, the vine runs through
Every servant at his feet, what else you want, true?
Orders up, orders up, yahushua takes a seat We serve him with the love, hustle and the heat
On the bus, boy, chef, GM at the lead We wait on the master til he says, you're free
So polish every glass and fold every napkin The king walks through, his love never lacking
We his servants, loyal to the call His restaurant, his kingdom
We gon' give it all
